checkpoints.name: linear_3lcc_exp_lower_bound
checkpoints.description: Theorem 1 of Kothari-Manohar (arXiv 2311.00558v1), binary normal-form version: there is an absolute constant C > 0 such that every linear 3-query LCC in normal form satisfies k <= C*(log2 n)^8/delta^2. The GKST06 2-LDC lower bound (Fact 2.5) is taken as a hypothesis.
